notes:
# Your phone stops saying the Mac is offline {link}
The remote showed "reconnecting", then "offline", with the Mac awake and
answering in a third of a second — the connection had gone half-open and
nothing could tell that from a quiet one. The Mac now notices the network
going within seconds rather than minutes, and reconnects within seconds of
it coming back.

# Read the transcript, not the video {notes}
"View transcript" used to open the player, with the words down the side of
a picture. It now opens the words on their own: every line timed, the one
being spoken lit, and search that filters as you type. Click a line to
hear it.

# Names on the right lines {mic}
Every line of a transcript said "Meeting audio", even in a six-person
class. The name now comes from Zoom's own active-speaker mark, read in the
meeting's own window rather than the toast that sits in front of it.

# The simple screen follows your window {sparkle}
It fills the window now, full screen included, instead of sitting in a
fixed column that drifted sideways as you resized. Up next and This week
sit side by side at any size, and it says when Zoom has been spotted.

---

Everything else in this release:

- A long transcript opens at once. Rendering it line by line took seconds
  on a two-hour meeting; only the lines on screen are drawn now.
- The System Check keeps itself up to date: something that fixes itself no
  longer waits for you to press Check again, and a window it opened on its
  own closes once everything passes.
- It also stops appearing for a moment while you change WiFi, and stops
  calling a flat battery or an unreachable remote a permission.
- Your phone keeps its pairing when the Mac cannot read its list of paired
  phones. It used to be told it had been unpaired, which a phone acts on by
  forgetting the Mac.
- The elapsed time on the simple screen no longer sticks at 0:01, and the
  home button no longer appears on the home screen.
- The prompt for what Gemini should look for can be scrolled past four
  lines, and asking a recording a question works after a follow-up.
- "Transcribe again" says "Transcribing…" while it runs, instead of going
  quietly grey.
- Reading a transcript beside the video no longer drags itself back to the
  top when you scroll.
- A failed join no longer leaves its browser pages open, launching another
  Zoom each time. The last page stays, so you can see why it failed.
- Stop a recording from the home card; change what can still be changed on
  a run's own page; and pick a meeting's time zone where the flow asks for
  it.
